notes.title: 4/2 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Dear Immortals:
Rise of Eros will update at 11:00 (UTC+8) on Apr 2 (Tue). The servers will remain online during this update.

※ Once the update is complete, Immortals may restart the game and download the latest data.
※ Please remember to bind your account to prevent the loss of in-game data. If you have any queries, please contact us at ask-riseoferos@pinkcore.com.
※ Note: the browser version of the game will be down from 10:30 (UTC+8).

◆ Update Details ◆
a. "Pilgrimage to the Fukatsuki Seichi ~ Past and present spiralling in steam and smoke ~" Now Available
"Deep in the forests upon the mountaintop, the spring waters bubble and flow endlessly as a symbol of our family's fortunes...
Just remember, nobody but the heads of our household must ever set foot in the sacred Seichi!"
—Ancient Fukatsuki Teaching

Availability:
2024/4/2 11:00 ~ 2024/4/30 10:59 (UTC+8)

Prerequisites:
Clear Story Stage 2-5

Chapter Release Schedule:
[Seichi's Anomaly] Release Date: 2024/4/2 11:00 (UTC+8)
[Contaminated Holy Spring] Release Date: 2024/4/2 11:00 (UTC+8)
[Seichi's Trial I] Release Date: 2024/4/9 11:00 (UTC+8)
[Seichi's Trial II] Release Date: 2024/4/16 11:00 (UTC+8)

How to play:
While the Event is running,
Experience the plot in the [Seichi's Anomaly] chapters.
Enjoy the battle in the [Contaminated Holy Spring] chapters.
Claim Event Points and [Prajna Mask] Event Items from the [Seichi's Anomaly] and [Contaminated Holy Spring] chapters.
Exchange [Prajna Mask] for products in the Event Store.
Besides Evolve Materials and Incense, rewards include [Dream Crystal], [Deity Contract], and the Event-Limited Summon Ticket [Bond Contract].
Challenges of varying difficulty and fabulous prizes await players in [Seichi's Trial I] and [Seichi's Trial II]. Clear the Stages to win Rewards including [Dream Crystal].
In addition to various materials and Dream Crystals, there are also exquisite Personal Profile backgrounds waiting for players in the event's lottery box. Don't miss out!

b. [Divine Power Deathmatch Season 14] Now Available
Event Time:
2024/4/9 11:00 ~ 2024/4/16 10:59 (UTC+8)

Prerequisites: Clear Story Stage 2-10

How to Play:

Use [Deathmatch Ticket] to enter the stage and challenge the Limited-Time Boss.
All difficulties are available at launch.
Before entering the results screen, redoing or abandoning the challenge will not consume any [Deathmatch Ticket].
Upon entering the arena, three parties must be formed. Each party must have at least one Persona.
Every day, 3 [Deathmatch Ticket] will be replenished. No tickets will be replenished if you have 6 or more tickets.
The Limited-Time Boss will use completely different skill sets based on the amount of remaining HP. Attacking will require careful observation and clever tactics.
If the HP of the Limited-Time Boss has not been reduced to 0 within 10 turns or the entire party is defeated, the second and third parties will enter the arena to take on the challenge until the Limited-Time Boss has been vanquished, the three parties are defeated, or the Limited-Time Boss makes more than 30 moves.
If a party is defeated by the Limited-Time Boss before it makes 10 moves, the defeated party will be deemed to have let the Limited-Time Boss make 10 moves.
After vanquishing the Limited-Time Boss, Deathmatch points will be awarded based on the number of turns, the amount of HP lost, and the number of survivors.
Divine Power Deathmatch has a leaderboard. Research the best strategy to get the highest possible score! Reward Info:
Accumulate Deathmatch points to obtain rare rewards such as Gold, Dream Crystals, Divine Power Exchange Tokens, and Realm-Shattering Jade.
Divine Power Exchange Tokens can be exchanged in the Divine Power Deathmatch Store for rewards such as Realm-Shattering Jade and Legendary Gear Exchange Currency.
Other Explanations:
※ Our team will from time to time ban accounts that violate the regulations. Players are asked to abide by the rules to maintain a positive gaming environment.

c. New Personas
★SSR Celestial Fox Miriam
★SSR Pure Moon Misaki

d. [Pilgrimage to the Fukatsuki Seichi] Login Event
Availability:
2024/4/2 11:00 ~ 2024/4/30 10:59 (UTC+8)

Log in to the game during the event period to collect amazing rewards!

※ The login card will disappear after logging in to the game for 14 days.
※ Login rewards will automatically be sent to your Inventory when you log in to the game.

e. Limited Summon Pool [Goddess Summon - Secret Realm]
Event Duration:
2024/4/2 11:00 ~ 2024/5/7 10:59 (UTC+8)

During this event, the chance of pulling [Celestial Fox Miriam] and [Pure Moon Misaki] from the [Goddess Summon - Secret Realm] pool will be greatly increased!

※ An SSR Persona is guaranteed from this Summon Pool after 100 Summons. Only the SSR Personas included in this Summon Pool may be pulled; please consult [Probabilities] in the lower-left corner of the Summon screen for details.
※ If an SSR prize is drawn, the accumulated number of summons will be reset.
※ Earn 1 Bond Insignia with each Summon from this Summon Pool. Exchange 300 Bond Insignia for [Celestial Fox Miriam] or [Pure Moon Misaki] in the Bond Insignia Store.
※ [Celestial Fox Miriam] and [Pure Moon Misaki] will be unavailable from the Bond Insignia Store once this Limited-Time Summon Pool ends.
※ Bond Insignia and Purity Inscriptions may still be used in the Bond Insignia Store and Purity Inscription Store during future Limited-Time Summon Pools, and will not expire or automatically exchange for Deity Insignia once this Summon Pool ends.
※ [Celestial Fox Miriam] and [Pure Moon Misaki] will not be added to the Normal Summon Pool after the Limited-Time Summon Pool closes.

f. Limited Summon Pool [Relic Summon - Secret Realm]
Event Duration:
2024/4/2 11:00 ~ 2024/5/7 10:59 (UTC+8)

During this event, the chance of pulling [Astara's Enchantment] and [Arkuran's Demon Breaker] from the [Relic Summon - Secret Realm] pool will be greatly increased!

※ Use [Relic Contract] or [Deity Contract] for summons in the Limited [Relic Summon].
※ Earn 1 Deity Insignia with each Summon from this Summon Pool. Exchange 150 Deity Insignia for [Astara's Enchantment] or [Arkuran's Demon Breaker] in the Deity Insignia Store.
※ [Astara's Enchantment] and [Arkuran's Demon Breaker] will be permanently added to the Deity Insignia Store.
※ [Astara's Enchantment] and [Arkuran's Demon Breaker] will not be added to the Normal Summon Pool after the Limited-Time Summon Pool closes.

g. Limited Boudoir Accessory Summon Pool [Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse]
Event Time:
2024/4/9 11:00 ~ 2024/4/30 10:59 (UTC+8)

During this event, players will be able to pull Phoenix's exclusive Boudoir Accessory set [Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse] from the Summon Pool!

※ A Boudoir Accessory set is guaranteed from the Summon Pool after 10 Summons. Please check the list of other obtainable rewards in the [Probabilities] in the lower-left corner of the Summon screen.
※ Only [Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] may be used to draw from this Summon Pool. [Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] can be purchased from the Store.
※ The number of [Seductive Contracts (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] required for each summon in this Summon Pool will gradually increase with each summon you make.
※ [Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] will be converted to Gold (1 contract: 100,000 Gold) and sent to your in-game mailbox after the Limited Boudoir Accessory Summon Pool [Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse] closes.
※ [Seductive Contracts (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] can only be used in the Limited Boudoir Accessory Summon Pool [Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse].
※ In this Summon Pool, each Summon provides an opportunity to receive one of the available rewards. Once a reward is obtained, it will be removed from the pool and unavailable for future summons.
※ Summon probabilities and the rewards available will change according to the number of summons made. Please see [Probabilities] for details.
※ There are 10 different rewards in this Summon Pool. Once all 10 rewards have been claimed, this Summon Pool will be closed.
※ After receiving all rewards, you will receive a [Perfect Reward]. ※ After the Limited Boudoir Accessory Summon Pool for [Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse] closes, Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse will be available for purchase in the store in the form of a bundle in the future.

[Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse)] Products

Availability: 2024/4/9 11:00 ~ 2024/4/30 10:59 (UTC+8)
Products: Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse) x2, Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse) x12, Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse) x1 (limited)
Price: 345 / 1,660 Ecoins, USD$ 4.99 / 23.99, 549 / 2,639 Nutaku Gold; 360 Dream Crystals

Please Note: Seductive Contracts will be converted into Gold once the summon pool closes. (100,000 Gold/Seductive Contract (Phoenix - Mischievous Nurse) x1)

notes.title: 3/19 Update Preview
notes.notes:
3/19 Update [Persona adjustments & Awakening effects available]
※ Increased the basic value of the New Year (Re) Personas, [Vesperthorn Cartilla] and [Midnight Moon Misaki]. For further details please check out the ""Announcement Regarding Adjustments to Persona Combat Stats and Awaken Stat Bonuses"" that was released on 2023/04/03.

Updated Vesperthorn Cartilla's skills and added Awakening effects to her skills
※ The following values are for skill level 7 and do not include awakening effects.

Basic Attack:
Original Skill:
The target takes damage equal to 150+125% of ATK; bestow 1 stack of Revenge on self.
Adjusted:
The target takes damage equal to 200+145% of ATK; bestow 1 stack of Revenge on self.

Awaken: Increase the skill damage buff by an additional 50%.
Insatiable:
Original Skill:
The target takes damage equal to 250+250% of ATK.
Passive: Bestow 2% Absorb on self for every stack of Revenge.
Adjusted:
The target takes damage equal to 400+350% of ATK.
Passive: Bestow 2% Absorb on self for every stack of Revenge.

Awaken: Bestow 2 additional stacks of Revenge on self.
Denigrate
Original Skill:
The target takes damage equal to 350+350% of ATK; bestow 2 stacks of Revenge on self.
Adjusted:
The target takes damage equal to 500+450% of ATK; bestow 2 stacks of Revenge on self.

Awaken: If the caster has 10 stacks of Revenge, deal additional damage to all enemies equal to 150% of ATK.
Updated Midnight Moon Misaki's skills and added Awakening effects to her skills
※ The following values are for skill level 7 and do not include awakening effects.

Basic Attack:
Original Skill:
The target takes damage equal to 100+125% of ATK, with a 100% chance of inflicting Taunt for 2 turns; bestow 1 stack of Revenge on self.
Adjusted:
The target takes damage equal to 200+125% of DEF, with a 100% chance of inflicting Taunt for 2 turns; bestow 1 stack of Revenge on self.

Awaken: Increase the skill damage buff by an additional 50%.
Engorged:
Original Skill:
The target takes damage equal to 150+200% of DEF.
Passive: Bestow an additional 3% Damage Reduction on self for every stack of Revenge.
Adjusted:
The target takes damage equal to 400+300% of DEF.
Passive: Bestow an additional 3% Damage Reduction on self for every stack of Revenge.

Awaken: Passive: At the start of the turn, bestow 1 stack of Revenge on self.
Night Dance:
Original Skill:
Replenish HP equal to 500+200% of DEF, and bestow 2 stacks of Revenge on self. Adjusted:
Replenish HP equal to 500+250% of DEF, and bestow 2 stacks of Revenge on self.

Awaken: If the caster has 10 stacks of Revenge, additionally replenish other allies' HP equal to 125% of the caster's DEF.
Brand-new System [Event Rewind] Now Available
Availability:
2024/03/19 11:00 (UTC+8) ~ Permanent

After the update, players can enter the ""Event Rewind"" system page by selecting the ""Events"" category on the chapter selection page and tapping the system entry at the top right corner.
After selecting the desired event within the ""Event Rewind"" page, you can unlock the event using the ""Hourglass of Memories"" and play all the story stages of that event at any time.
After completing all the story stages, you'll be able to claim the ""Perfect Rewind"" reward.

System Gameplay: Enter the event page and tap the ""Event Rewind"" button to enter the system.
Tap on the past event you wish to play to enter the event page and learn about the event information. Use the ""Hourglass of Memories"" to unlock the event and you will be able to play all the stages of the event and receive rewards!

※ Each ""Perfect Rewind"" reward can only be claimed once.
※ Each event has its own ""Rewind Progress"" and ""Perfect Rewind"" reward.
※ ""Hourglass of Memories"" can be obtained from the Monthly Store and Event Store.
※ After the update, The Jokers' Banquet, All Saints' Eve, and Waterside Rhapsody will be added to the ""Event Rewind"" system.
※ After the system is available, past events that can be unlocked for play will be gradually added.

"1.5th Anniversary Celebration" Login Event

Event Period:
2024/3/19 11:00 ~ 2024/4/2 10:59 (UTC +8)

Celebrate the 1.5th Anniversary of Rise of Eros!
During the event period, log in to the game daily to receive bountiful rewards such as "Bond Contract", "Relic Contract", 'Divine Testimony", and more!
※ The login card will disappear after logging in to the game for 14 days.
※ Login rewards will automatically be sent to your Inventory when you log in to the game.

After selecting the desired event within the "Event Rewind" page, you can unlock the event using the "Hourglass of Memories" and play all the story stages of that event at any time. 
After completing all the story stages, you'll be able to claim the "Perfect Rewind" reward. 


System Gameplay: Enter the event page and tap the "Event Rewind" button to enter the system. 
Tap on the past event you wish to play to enter the event page and learn about the event information. Use the "Hourglass of Memories" to unlock the event and you will be able to play all the stages of the event and receive rewards! 

※ Each "Perfect Rewind" reward can only be claimed once. 
※ Each event has its own "Rewind Progress" and "Perfect Rewind" reward. 
※ "Hourglass of Memories" can be obtained from the Monthly Store and Event Store. 
※ After the update, The Jokers' Banquet, All Saints' Eve, and Waterside Rhapsody will be added to the "Event Rewind" system. 
※ After the system is available, past events that can be unlocked for play will be gradually added.
